summary: A local official asks what protections a city would give up under a uniform state rule.
realLife: Washington House report on ESSB 5323, 2020. House staff recorded support for state preemption conditional on keeping a strong statewide standard.
inGame: needs: the state proposal would displace an existing city ordinance.
gates: The state proposal would displace an existing city ordinance.
